citation: Hedrington MS, Tate DB, Younk LM, et al. Effects of Antecedent GABA A Receptor Activation on Counterregulatory Responses to Exercise in Healthy Man. Diabetes. 2015.
licence: ADA custom terms (no Creative Commons licence): readers may use as long as properly cited, educational and not for profit, and not altered
protocol: Day 2, after overnight fast: 90 min continuous cycling at 50% of individual VO2max with a variable 20% dextrose infusion to hold euglycaemia and [3H]glucose tracer; day 1 was euglycaemia or hypoglycaemia, with or without alprazolam
population: Protocol 1-4 of 31 healthy individuals (16 M, 15 F, age 28+/-1, BMI 23+/-3, VO2max 39+/-2 mL/kg/min)
note: Exercise under a glucose infusion (euglycaemic). Use the 'prior euglycaemia, no alprazolam' arm; others are antecedent hypoglycaemia or drug arms. Table 2 gives HR/BP at baseline and end of exercise; Table 1 is resting baseline. Hormone time courses are in figures.
